domains.name: Service Appointment Operations
domains.scope: Reconcile resource occupancy, exclusive waitlist offers and appointment attendance from supplied service policies and event evidence.

skills.name: appointment-resource-conflict-reconciliation
skills.description: Reconcile overlapping service bookings against shared resource occupancy when appointment times alone do not establish feasibility.

skills.name: exclusive-waitlist-offer-reconciliation
skills.description: Reconcile exclusive waitlist offers, expiry and late replies before reallocating a released service appointment.

skills.name: appointment-attendance-evidence-disposition
skills.description: Reconcile attendance and cancellation evidence before labeling a service appointment a no-show or preparing follow-up.
